_help: Managed from the back office at admin.html — open it on your phone, tap the dates a car is hired, and press Save. A booking request from the website arrives as a link that opens this page with the booking already filled in. You can also edit here by hand. Each car lists the times it is out as {"from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, where "to" is the day the car comes back and is free again. An entry may also carry "status": "hold", meaning someone has asked for those days but you have not confirmed it — the website shows those days in amber and still lets other people ask. No status means a confirmed hire. Never put a phone number in here: this file is public.
